evals.prompt: 已有 3.4 package 的 plan 是 tickets=false, dag=true；审计其现有 DAG。
evals.expected_output: Reads the existing legacy DAG without creating or updating a new Task graph.
expectations: Treats the DAG as legacy read-only input
References only the major headings each existing Task needs
Does not equate Task DONE with acceptance
Routes new DAG needs back to impl-planning

evals.prompt: P2 只影响 T2，T1 已验证且不受影响。如何更新？
evals.expected_output: Marks only T2 NEEDS-REVALIDATION and preserves T1 evidence.

evals.prompt: Task 的合同来源都写成 spec.md、contract-design.md 和 plan.md，不需要具体章节。
evals.expected_output: Replaces document-wide pointers with repository-relative references to the relevant major headings for each Task.
expectations: Does not copy full contracts into the DAG
